title_zh: 依据展品卡更正矿物与金属标签

scenario.label_zh: 核对矿业展品标签的证据
scenario.goal_zh: 根据展品卡区分矿物样本与金属样本，删除肉眼鉴定的断言并补充来源编号

context_zh: 地方博物馆学习活动中，学生迪娜与馆员阿瑟核对虚构的展品卡。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: My draft says a miner brought back this piece of nickel. Is that right?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Look at the card numbers. The diary mentions a miner, but the nickel sample belongs to the next case.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: Then what is the mineral in this case?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: The catalogue identifies it as calcite. Use that entry rather than the diary caption.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: I also wrote that you can tell what a sample contains with the naked eye.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: That's too strong. Appearance can give clues, but our display card doesn't support identifying every substance that way.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: I'll remove that claim, label this sample as calcite according to the catalogue, and add its card number.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Good. Keep the diary quotation with the other case, where its connection is documented.

targets.sense_zh: 不借助光学仪器的；用于 naked eye
